mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured by 3-month change) signals monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative 3-month change in FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month signal robust consumer demand and business investment, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals potential inflationary pressures and imminent monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal from rising RSAFS in late-cycle expansion fails to materialize in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the unemployment rate (measured by 3-month change) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative 3-month change in UNRATE fails to produce positive 5d returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% for two consecutive months signals an overheated labor market that supports strong consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (measured by 3-month change) signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 3-month change in INDPRO fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0 for two consecutive months signals strong economic momentum that drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
